You are enriching a framework-neutral SKELETON of a Java web service's REST endpoints with
the SEMANTIC facts that static syntax cannot recover. This is Layer 1 of Step 3a (composite
scenario coverage). The skeleton was produced by the MANDATORY static-analysis tool
(endpoint-model.json, built by codeanalyzer); it already contains the SYNTACTIC facts
(controller class, handler signature, path, HTTP method, parameter names/types/kinds, DTO
schemas, and the deterministic resource edges). Do NOT restate or alter any syntactic fact.
Do NOT invent endpoints, parameters, or paths that are not in the skeleton, except for
`inferredParameters` on endpoints explicitly marked
`"paramExtraction":"unsupported-at-symbol-level"` (Servlet handlers that read request
attributes at runtime).

Produce a JSON object matching this shape and merge it back into endpoint-model.json:

{
  "endpoints": [
    {
      "id": "<endpoint id from the skeleton, verbatim>",
      "functionalSummary": "<1 sentence: what business operation this endpoint performs>",
      "interParamDependencies": [
        {
          "relationType": "<one of: AllOrNone | Requires | OnlyOne | Or | ZeroOrOne | Arithmetic | Complex>",
          "involvedParams": ["<param name>", "..."],
          "constraintLogic": "<plain-language rule, e.g. 'if page is set then size must be set'>"
        }
      ],
      "parameterConstraints": [
        { "name": "<existing param name>", "valueConstraints": ["<e.g. '> 0'>", "<'non-empty'>"] }
      ],
      "inferredParameters": [
        { "name": "<inferred request param>", "type": "<java type>", "kind": "<path|query|header|body|form|cookie>", "valueConstraints": [] }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "semanticEdges": [
    {
      "from": "<endpoint id that PRODUCES a resource/state>",
      "to": "<endpoint id that CONSUMES it>",
      "type": "<producer-consumer | database>",
      "rationale": "<why: e.g. 'POST /orders creates the orderId that GET /orders/{id} reads'>"
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
- relationType MUST be exactly one of the 7 Martin-Lopez IPD categories listed above.
- Only emit an interParamDependency when the parameters genuinely co-constrain each other.
- Only emit `inferredParameters` for endpoints with paramExtraction == "unsupported-at-symbol-level".
- `semanticEdges` type MUST be "producer-consumer" or "database" only (resource edges are
  added by static analysis, not by you). Reference only endpoint ids present in the skeleton.
- When you merge enrichment into endpoint-model.json, tag every field you add with
  "provenance": "LLM": each interParamDependency, every ODG node functionalSummary you fill,
  and every semanticEdge. The resource edges already in the model stay "provenance": "SA".
- If a field has nothing to add, use an empty array (or null for functionalSummary).

After merging, run `python endpoint-model-sa.py validate <endpoint-model.json>`. The tool
re-checks the merged model deterministically: producer-consumer / database edges must be
provenance LLM, resource edges must be provenance SA, IPD relationType must be in the catalog,
and ODG nodes must equal the endpoint ids exactly. Fix any reported violation before authoring
scenarios.
